children: Juniper Hotels Limited on Wednesday announced a proposed acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa, an operating hotel in Khopoli, Maharashtra, from Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited (formerly Adlabs Entertainment Limited) for ₹248 crore, or approximately ₹86 lakh per key.

The board approved the deal and a related Memorandum of Understanding at its meeting held today. The transaction is a straight cash deal with no share issuance involved and is not classified as a related-party transaction.

title: Juniper Hotels to acquire Novotel Imagicaa for ₹248 crore
